heading: Your gift

claim.title: Claim your gift
claim.createText: Create a free account to keep these in your Library. No payment details needed.
claim.loginText: Log in to add these to your Library.
claim.emailHint: The gift was sent to this address. You can use another.
claim.terms: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms>.

ready.title: Add to your Library
ready.text_one: This title will be added to your account, ready to download.
ready.text_other: These {{count}} titles will be added to your account, ready to download.
ready.fine: The sender is not charged again and will not see your Library.

done.title: It’s yours. Added to your Library.
done.text_one: {{name}} sent you a title. You can download it now or any time from your Library.
done.text_other: {{name}} sent you {{count}} titles. You can download them now or any time from your Library.
done.thanksPlaceholder: Thanks! Can’t wait to run it.

claimed.title: This gift was already claimed
claimed.text: It was added to a Library on {{date}}. If that was you, your titles are waiting.
claimed.fine: Not you? Tell us and we’ll look into it.

expired.title: This gift link has expired
expired.text: We can send a fresh one to the email address the gift was sent to.
expired.sent: New link sent. Check your inbox.
expired.fine: Sent to {{email}}. Wrong address? Ask {{name}} to resend the gift.

invalid.title: We can’t open this gift link
invalid.text: It may have been copied incompletely. Open the link from the original email, or enter the gift code from it.

loadErrorText: Check your connection and try again. The gift is safe.
